# TID Podcast — The Innovators and Disruptors Podcast

> India's leading long-form podcast on innovation and entrepreneurship. Hosted by Abhay Tandon, it features weekly conversations with India's top founders, CEOs, and corporate innovation leaders. Available on YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts.

## About

TID Podcast is the flagship media property of TID Collective. The show launched in 2024 and is currently in Season 2, with parallel mini-series running on India's Global Capability Centre (GCC) ecosystem and a Founders Corner series for India's most ambitious early-stage founders. Episodes are unscripted long-form conversations, typically 60–90 minutes, with no edits.

- **Host**: Abhay Tandon — founder of TID Collective, TEDx 2025 speaker, Forbes Technology Council member, angel investor in 30+ early-stage startups, G20 Summit speaker on India's innovation potential.
- **YouTube channel**: @TheInnovatorsandDisruptorsPodc
- **Frequency**: Weekly drops
- **Topics covered**: FinTech, deep tech, AI, aviation, retail, FMCG, gaming, mobility, spirituality for leaders, India's GCC ecosystem, corporate innovation, venture capital
- **Recorded in**: Bengaluru and Mumbai

## About the host (Abhay Tandon)

Abhay Tandon is a global corporate-innovation leader. Over his career he has led innovation programs across Retail, FMCG and Mobility, executed 50+ deep-tech projects spanning NanoTech, Drones, Haptics, AR/VR/XR and Quantum Computing, and angel-invested in 30+ early-stage startups. In 2021 he was recognised as one of India's Top 10 Corporate Innovation Leaders. In 2024 he won the IAMAI Gold Award for Innovation in e-Commerce and launched The Innovators and Disruptors Podcast. In 2025 he delivered his TEDx talk "From Observation to Breakthroughs" and represented India at the G20 Summit. He is an upcoming author on Corporate Innovation.

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhaytandon/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/theinnovatorsanddisruptors/
